full_run.rule: Projected time = seconds per bio of the chosen count x the number of showcase-subset bios, main model. If it exceeds 3 hours, fall back to leave-one-out occlusion.

cost_pilot.rule: 50 random showcase-subset bios, the primary removal, the permutation counts 5, 10, 20 and 40 with seeds 0 and 1 each. Seed agreement of a bio is the Spearman correlation between the values of its two seeds (bios with fewer than 2 words or constant values are left out). The permutation count is the smallest whose median Spearman is at least 0.9; if none reaches it, the largest is used and `threshold_met` is false.

removal_pilot.rule: Drop 30% of the words of each of 200 random dev bios, the same words for both removals, 5 times. The removal with the smaller mean macro-F1 drop (macro-F1 on the unchanged bios minus macro-F1 on the changed ones) is the primary removal; the other is used in #9. A tie goes to delete.
